title: Betta Fish Diseases and Health Warning Signs | BettaFish.website
description: Understand betta health warning signs, water-quality checks and the limits of online disease guidance.
h1: Start with symptoms, water and urgency
intro: Betta fish diseases can share similar symptoms but have different causes. Check the environment, document what changed and avoid treating a webpage as a veterinary diagnosis.

sections.heading: A safer first response
sections.intro: Use observation to decide urgency before reaching for a treatment.

steps.title: Test the water
steps.text: Record temperature, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate and any recent maintenance change.

steps.title: Describe the symptom
steps.text: Note breathing, appetite, swimming, skin, fins, waste and how quickly the change developed.

steps.title: Reduce avoidable stress
steps.text: Correct unsafe water and isolate aggression without making several chemical changes at once.

steps.title: Escalate when necessary
steps.text: Rapid decline, severe breathing difficulty, major injury or uncertainty may require an aquatic veterinarian.

sections.heading: Clinical guides
